text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne higher on CBOT calls and oversold sentiments from Monday's trade. Technical resistance seen in the July at C$388.70, then C$392.20. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +4.79 Monday from +2.78 Friday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3878 to the U.S. dollar, flat at 82.56 yen, rose to 1.2408 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 up on spill over support.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls. Alberta Wheat Pool was expected to continue selling spreads.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
